title: Normalized Reaction Event Envelope (draft)
description: DRAFT. Canonical shape for a single normalized onchain event relating to a Rearctor reaction. Field names and value domains are under research and are not final. This schema does not describe an implemented system.

schema_version.description: Draft revision of the envelope format. Not a released version number.

event_id.description: Stable identity derived from chain position. Used for consumer-side deduplication and for retraction. Format: block_hash colon log_index.

event_type.description: Kind of event. Closed set; payload shape depends on this value.

stage_at_event.description: Lifecycle stage at the time of the event. Enrichment, not raw log data.

chain_reference.description: Where this event occurred. Sufficient for independent verification.

block_timestamp.description: RFC 3339. Convenience only. Block height is authoritative for ordering and windows.

finality.description: Reorg posture. A consumer may reject events below its own confirmation requirement.

status.description: The value retracted indicates a previously emitted event whose block was orphaned. Retractions carry the original event_id.

payload.description: Event-specific fields. Intentionally open in this draft; per-type payload schemas are under research. All amounts are base-unit integers expressed as decimal strings.

enrichment.description: Derived context attached at the enrich stage. Facts only, never judgements. Whether enrichment belongs in the envelope at all is under research.

distance_to_threshold_usdc.description: Signed decimal string. Negative after the threshold has been crossed.

notes.description: Free-text annotation. Not interpreted. Used to mark illustrative events as non-normative.
